info.title: Forenotes REST API
info.description: Forenotes REST API route catalog, including name-based discovery, user-owned MCP token management, and investigation provenance review. REST uses the session cookie. The separate /mcp Streamable HTTP endpoint uses bearer tokens and MCP tool schemas; see the API Reference page for its workflow.

servers.description: Replace with your Forenotes server origin.

label.description: Trimmed nonempty label, at most 120 characters.

expiresAt.description: Omitted or null defaults to 90 days. Explicit expiry must be in the future and at most 365 days away.

items.description: CamelCase record fields depend on collection. Each record includes its UUID in id.

sourceLocator.description: Opaque metadata; Forenotes never fetches this locator.

evidenceIds.description: Existing same-case evidence UUIDs from the evidence collection.

observationIds.description: Existing same-case observation UUIDs from the observations collection.

get.description: Search incident name or summary with optional q. Matches literal text, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace; empty or omitted q lists accessible records. Returns UUIDs with readable context. Names may be duplicated; inspect context before writes. Response fields use snake_case.

parameters.name: caseId
parameters.description: Case UUID returned as cases[].id by GET /api/cases; use q to search case/client/summary first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional literal, case-insensitive text in incident name or summary. Empty text lists accessible records.

get.summary: List case investigation provenance or agent actions
get.description: Requires investigation:read in the case. Returns camelCase records. incidentId filters all collections; runId is ignored by runs; status applies only to runs. findings returns agent-created findings only. Request successive pages until items is shorter than limit.

parameters.name: caseId
parameters.description: Case UUID returned as cases[].id by GET /api/cases; use q to search case/client/summary first.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Collection to read: runs, evidence, observations, hypotheses, agent-created findings, or actions.

parameters.name: incidentId
parameters.description: Incident UUID returned as incidents[].id by GET /api/cases/{caseId}/incidents; use q to search name/summary.

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: Run UUID returned as items[].id by GET /api/cases/{caseId}/investigation/runs or id by MCP start_investigation_run. Ignored for the runs collection.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Run-status filter, applied only to runs; other collections ignore it.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–100

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based offset

get.description: List the signed-in user's token metadata using the session cookie. Token secrets are never included.

post.description: Create a user-owned MCP bearer token using the session cookie. Secret is returned only once and stored as a hash. Defaults to 90-day expiry, maximum 365 days. Token inherits current owner permissions and memberships. Bearer token authenticates /mcp only, not /api routes.

201.description: Token created; bearer secret returned once

token.description: Copy once; only returned on creation.

delete.description: Revoke one token owned by the signed-in user. Idempotent for an already revoked token; live MCP authentication immediately rejects revoked tokens.

404.description: Token not found for current user

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Token UUID returned as tokens[].id by GET /api/mcp-tokens or accessToken.id by POST /api/mcp-tokens. This is not the bearer secret.
